about.title: About Vetch
about.description: A focused, cross-platform media downloader powered by Rust, Tauri and yt-dlp.
about.engineDescription: Vetch uses local tools so media downloads stay on your device.
about.privacyDescription: Vetch has no analytics, accounts or product links. URLs and download history remain on this device.
about.licenseDescription: Vetch is built with Tauri, React, yt-dlp and FFmpeg. Their respective licenses apply.
